hooks.command: d="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/ricochet-rs/agent-instructions"; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; { [ -d "$d/.git" ] || git clone --quiet --filter=blob:none https://github.com/ricochet-rs/agent-instructions.git "$d"; } && sh "$d/scripts/bootstrap.sh" >/dev/null && printf 'Shared ricochet-rs instructions synchronized to %s. Do not fetch them again in this session.\n\n' "$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --short HEAD)" && cat "$d/instructions/global.md"
